#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

long long process(int n, int mod) {
    if (n <= 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    long long last_value = 17;
    long long total_value = 17;
    int max_size = (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 2 + 1;
    int flag = 1;
    vector<vector<long long>> dp_table(2, vector<long long>(max_size + 1, 0));
    dp_table[0][0] = 1;
    dp_table[0][1] = 2;
    dp_table[0][2] = 2;
    dp_table[0][3] = 1;
    for (int m = 4; m < n; ++m) {
        int pair_count = m * (m - 1) / 2;
        total_value = (long long)(m + 1) * last_value;
        long long cumulative = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            cumulative += dp_table[flag ^ 1][i];
            cumulative %= mod;
            dp_table[flag][i] = cumulative;
        }
        for (int i = m; i <= pair_count / 2; ++i) {
            cumulative += dp_table[flag ^ 1][i];
            cumulative -= dp_table[flag ^ 1][i - m];
            cumulative %= mod;
            if (cumulative < 0) cumulative += mod;
            dp_table[flag][i] = cumulative;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= pair_count / 2; ++i) {
            dp_table[flag][pair_count - i] = dp_table[flag][i];
        }
        long long total_sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < pair_count; ++i) {
            long long temp_sum = 0;
            int start_j = max(1, -pair_count + i + m + 2);
            for (int j = start_j; j <= m; ++j) {
                int index = m + 2 - j + i;
                if (index >= 0 && index <= max_size) {
                    temp_sum += (long long)j * dp_table[flag][index];

            total_sum += dp_table[flag][i];
            total_sum %= mod;
            temp_sum %= mod;
            total_value += temp_sum * total_sum;
            total_value %= mod;
        }
        last_value = total_value;
        flag ^= 1;
    }
    return total_value % mod;
}

    int n, mod;
    cin >> n >> mod;
    cout << process(n, mod) << endl;
    return 0;
}
